description: This is an ASP.NET code-behind file for the UserProfile page, which manages displaying user information and navigation actions within an online examination system. It retrieves user data from a SQL Server database using session-based identification and handles page navigation events.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Represents the code-behind for the UserProfile page, handling page load, data retrieval, and navigation events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, checks user session, retrieves user info from database, and populates the profile fields.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle profile button click, but currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the taken courses page.
